sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.body: “Service” means the {{brand}} mobile app and related services. “User” means an individual who accepts these Terms. “Partner” means a venue that provides services under the subscription.

sections.heading: 2. Subscription
sections.body: A subscription gives access to visits at partner venues within the limits of the chosen plan. The number of visits, available venues and validity period are stated in the plan.

sections.heading: 3. Payments
sections.body: Payments are made in UZS through the supported payment systems. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off in settings.

sections.heading: 4. Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: A booking can be cancelled without using up a visit until the venue's cancellation window closes. Refund terms for subscriptions are described in the public offer.

sections.heading: 5. Personal data
sections.body: Personal data is processed in accordance with the Privacy Policy and the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.

sections.heading: 6. Contacts
sections.body: Questions about the service are accepted through the Support section of the app. The operator's details will be added in the final version of this document.

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.body: The operator is {{brand}}. Personal data means any information relating to the User, including phone number, name and visit history.

sections.heading: 2. What we collect
sections.body: Phone number, name, language settings, booking and visit data, technical device data, and location — only with your permission.

sections.heading: 3. Why we process it
sections.body: Signing in, booking and confirming visits, booking notifications, improving the service and meeting legal requirements.

sections.heading: 4. Storage and sharing
sections.body: Data is stored in line with personal data localisation requirements. Partners receive only the information needed to confirm a visit.

sections.heading: 5. Your rights
sections.body: You can request a copy of your data, correct it or delete your account in the Profile section. Deletion requests are completed within the statutory period.

sections.heading: 6. Contacts
sections.body: For questions about personal data, contact us through the Support section. The operator's contact details will be added in the final version.

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.body: The offer is a proposal by {{brand}} to enter into an agreement on the terms below. Acceptance is the payment of a subscription in the app.

sections.heading: 2. Subject
sections.body: The operator gives the User access to visits at partner venues within the chosen plan, and the User pays for the subscription.

sections.heading: 3. Subscription
sections.body: A subscription is valid for one calendar month from the moment of payment. Unused visits do not carry over to the next period.

sections.heading: 4. Payments
sections.body: Plan prices are shown in the app in UZS. Payments are accepted via Payme, Click and Uzum. A receipt is sent once the payment is confirmed.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: You can cancel at any time; access continues until the end of the paid period. Refunds for the unused period are made in the cases provided by law.

sections.heading: 6. Contacts
sections.body: The operator's details, address and contact information will be provided in the final version of the offer.
